items.title: Skyblock Skins
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
A set inspired by the incredibly popular 'Skyblock' gamemode! With a cobblestone generator, a mini island, a single tree and more!

- 8 skins!
- Each skin is designed to capture a different part of Skyblock!

items.title: ONE BLOCK WORLD!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Time to play some one block! Every time the block breaks it's replaced with a new block! We challenge you to defeat the Ender Dragon!

items.title: Gold Rush Tycoon
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the gold mines, you have been selected to mine and become rich!
Fight off mobs in the arena, mine gold, or upgrade machines like the drills, smelter, or press to increase your earnings. 

+ 4 upgradeable machines
+ Mob arena
+ Licensed by Levelatics and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Cute Robots
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Robots from the future are here... and they are cute too! With a unique twist on humanoid robotic designs, these cute robots are the perfect helpful companion. Role-play with your friends, explore automated modern cities, and compete in robot competitions together! One free skin included.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Black Out
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Black out your attire with your favorite color. These skins will be perfect any time of the year! Featuring the only color that goes with everything! You're bound to be cool wearing these with your friends!

items.title: Trendy Halloween Friends
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Trick or treat! Halloween is just around the corner! Get into the Halloween spirit and let your friends know you want to go trick or treating this year with these stylish scary clothes. This might be the most frightening night of the year for some, but for you, this is where you let your true self out.

+ 1 free skin 
+ 11 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Playroom
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Play with your toys by becoming the size of one! Some will be your friend. Others don't play nice. Ride a train and fight mice between the walls. Computer viruses can come to life. Craft special vehicles like a toy mech. Glide through the bedroom on a paper plane. Help dolls in a huge dollhouse.
- 33 toys
- 5 crafting recipes
- 5 skins

Tons of fun things to do!

items.title: Craftable Construction Trucks
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft your own construction trucks that really work! Use the bulldozer to plow through blocks, the wrecking ball to demolish buildings, the drilling machine to drive through anything, and more. The vast city is perfect for roleplaying as a construction crew.
- 9 vehicles
- 11 crafting recipes
- 5 skins
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer

Build it up and knock it down!

items.title: Cursed Outpost
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description:
After a hard journey, you land your air balloon on an outpost’s landing platform. Immediately something feels wrong. Two ships are docked much too close and no movement can be detected. A dread creeps up your spine. Do you enter the outpost, what about the ancient temple on top? 
- Survival spawn

items.title: Lucky Blocks Wild
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Lucky Block Wild is a world filled with lots of crazy lucky blocks to break!
One outcome might be positive while another might harm you! There are endless outcomes when you break these mysterious lucky blocks. Can you defeat the Ender Dragon?

items.title: Skyblock One Block
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Skyblock One Block is the hottest new take on your favorite game mode! With a special block that regenerates after every break, test your luck with random items drops or mobs spawning!

+ Single and multiplayer compatible
+ 2 maps to play on
+ Fun for all

items.title: Warm Summer Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Summer has arrived and the sun has never shined this bright before! Enjoy these fresh clothing items with your friends while having fun in the sunlight. Impress everybody you walk by and radiate coolness!

+ 1 FREE skin
+ 11 teen skins
+ Perfect for role-playing

items.title: Animal Kingdom
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
A small kingdom of various animals ready to go out and explore beyond the walls to see all the people, dressing in cute and fashionable attire for all of your friends.

Includes:
Bright colors, cute hats, and much much more.

- Khirbi

items.title: Beach Party
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
It would be great to party down on the beach, sunbathing or surfing some incredible waves. Grab your friends, enjoy the summer sun and join the party with these beautiful outfits, perfect for the summer heat!

+ 12 skins for boys and girls!
+ Perfect for roleplaying
+ By Withercore

items.title: Pop Stars
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Loud music. Chill beats. Live audience. The vibe is right! It's a great time to be a popstar, living a free life! We go where we please!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cool fashion attire inspired by pop stars!

items.title: Demon Teens 3
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
These demons sure know how to be stylish. They’re up to no good, and they want you to join them for the fun of it! Unleash your sinister side with a trendy modern teen style with our latest skin pack, Demon Teens!

+ 12 teen skins!
+ Perfect for roleplaying!

items.title: Young Rich Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Hey peeps! We don't even need to tell you that we are poppin' in style! You can just feel our vibes! Catch some of this drip before you miss it! 

+ 20 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire!

items.title: Halloween Party
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
The Halloween party has started! Take your costume and scare everyone with amazing costumes.

+ 10 skins (1 free!)

items.title: Magic Weapons
items.creator: Logdotzip
items.description:
Magic Weapons adds over 30 new weapons to your Minecraft experience. Help the Forge Master craft these elemental weapons and add them to your collection. Wield a Fire Sword, Air Staff, Electric Gauntlets or many more and take on the Ender Dragon!

30+ Magic Weapons
6 Custom Armor Sets
4 Rideable Mobs
9 NPC Characters
12 HD Skins

items.title: BEDWARS!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Bedwars with three different maps and Lucky Block mode! Choose one of the three maps and one of the four modes to play with friends. Change your game up every time with the custom settings and challenge your friends! Gather resources from the islands, defend your bed and trade for better equipment!
+ Villager shop
+ Lucky Blocks
+ Four custom modes
+ Three different maps

items.title: Parkour Cubes
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour! Parkour to the next stage and watch as the scenery changes as you progress to the finish line!

items.title: Skyblock $1000000
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: A rich life awaits in the sky! A mansion that's yours and yours only! Will you be able to survive and flourish? Let's find out!

items.title: Space Trend
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Do you dream of exploring outer space? Maybe being colorful astronauts? And maybe even going with some friends? Introducing space trend! The one and only space expedition team with style! Exploring space never looked so good!

items.title: Dark Gold
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: The royal dark gold family has arrived. No other group can be equally terrifying and stylish. The beautiful color scheme, the dark and scary aesthetic, and the incredible style!
